answer: Because the entropy is measured at the basalt gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the fable audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 6 bits per word is rejected before grading, because it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. A farm emitting 156 variations of one paragraph therefore forfeits for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the tundra panel. That is 33 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
